execute.title: Orchestrate the pipeline
execute.summary: Validate committed ownership, restore the admitted base, build, verify, persist and publish.
talk: This checkout keeps these phases in one method. The linked adapters expose the actual I/O.
A retained-all-excluded outcome finishes without publishing a replacement generation.

factory.title: Compose one admitted run
factory.summary: Build per-run connector dependencies, cancellation checks and bounded resources.
talk: Build per-run connector dependencies, cancellation checks and bounded resources.

restore.title: Restore the exact baseline
restore.summary: Validate the durable receipt and restore its three exact resources for retention-aware modeling.
talk: Validate the durable receipt and restore its three exact resources for retention-aware modeling.

candidate.title: Retrieve and model
candidate.summary: Coordinate bounded source work, model construction and candidate verification.
talk: Coordinate bounded source work, model construction and candidate verification.

build.title: Build three unified resources
build.summary: Produce one resource file per grain, preserving the evidence needed to retain valid baseline rows.
talk: Produce one resource file per grain, preserving the evidence needed to retain valid baseline rows.

verify.title: Verify modeled resources
verify.summary: Verify exact physical resources against the candidate and configured bounds.
talk: Verify exact physical resources against the candidate and configured bounds.

coverage.title: Check candidate coverage
coverage.summary: Require three matching resources with consistent row counts and usable coverage.
talk: Require three matching resources with consistent row counts and usable coverage.

persist.title: Persist verified files
persist.summary: Verify locally, determine generation-prefixed destinations and transfer exactly three resources.
talk: Verify locally, determine generation-prefixed destinations and transfer exactly three resources.

transfer.title: Transfer and verify
transfer.summary: Stream local bytes into the durable verified-transfer port and close the input stream.
talk: Stream local bytes into the durable verified-transfer port and close the input stream.

s3.title: Verify durable S3 bytes
s3.summary: Upload and verify the exact resource object through the S3 adapter. A durable receipt is not publication.
talk: Upload and verify the exact resource object through the S3 adapter. A durable receipt is not publication.

publish.title: Publish the generation
publish.summary: Validate descriptors and delegate to the atomic PostgreSQL publication transaction.
talk: Validate descriptors and delegate to the atomic PostgreSQL publication transaction.

atomic.title: Commit publication atomically
atomic.summary: Check live ownership and unchanged base, then persist descriptors, success and the active pointer in one transaction.
talk: Check live ownership and unchanged base, then persist descriptors, success and the active pointer in one transaction.

handoffs.label: Follow readers selecting the published generation

owned.title: Fence stale publishers
owned.summary: Require the exact run, owner identity, epoch and live lease.
talk: Require the exact run, owner identity, epoch and live lease.

finish.title: Finish without publication
finish.summary: Record failed or retained outcomes under the owner fence; preserve active published data.
talk: Record failed or retained outcomes under the owner fence; preserve active published data.

progress.title: Report bounded progress
progress.summary: Map connector stages and safe quality summaries into durable refresh progress.
talk: Map connector stages and safe quality summaries into durable refresh progress.

connector.title: RefreshConnector
connector.summary: Application-owned per-run capabilities connect the candidate to restoration, verification and durability.
talk: Application-owned per-run capabilities connect the candidate to restoration, verification and durability.

receipt.title: DurableResourceReceipt
receipt.summary: Three exact durable resource descriptors plus generation identity. A receipt alone does not switch readers.
talk: Three exact durable resource descriptors plus generation identity. A receipt alone does not switch readers.

candidateType.title: CandidateResult
candidateType.summary: Local modeled resources, summaries, interval and transformation identity before publication.
talk: Local modeled resources, summaries, interval and transformation identity before publication.

generation.title: Published generation
generation.summary: PostgreSQL owns exact resource descriptors and which generation readers select.
talk: PostgreSQL owns exact resource descriptors and which generation readers select.

putExact.title: Upload exact bytes
putExact.summary: Conditionally upload the expected bytes and verify the durable object through full readback.
talk: Conditionally upload the expected bytes and verify the durable object through full readback.

readback.title: Read and verify the durable file
readback.summary: Stream the exact object and verify its expected length and checksum.

flows.title: High-level diagram
flows.lead: The refresh pipeline combines admitted source data with the previous valid baseline, verifies three resource files and changes the published pointer only after durable verification.
flows.heading: Publish only a complete, verified generation.

lanes.title: Build the candidate
lanes.caption: All phases use the configuration and baseline selected at admission.

steps.title: Confirm ownership and base
steps.text: Require the committed claim and the original published baseline.

steps.title: Restore prior valid data
steps.text: When a baseline exists, restore and verify its exact resource files.

steps.title: Retrieve incoming observations
steps.text: Fetch the three source grains with bounded requests and explicit failure handling.

steps.title: Merge and calculate
steps.text: Apply invalid-row, duplicate, revision and retention rules while building one file per grain.

steps.title: Approve the candidate
steps.text: Check identity, coverage, counts and complete usable output before persistence.

lanes.title: Persist, then publish
lanes.caption: A successful upload alone does not make data visible to readers.

steps.title: Store three exact files
steps.text: Persist national, facilities and generators resources under the generation’s prefix.

steps.title: Read back and verify
steps.text: Read all three durable files and verify their exact expected contents.

steps.title: Commit publication
steps.text: Recheck ownership and base, then atomically store descriptors, success and the active pointer.

steps.title: Select the new generation
steps.text: New readers can select it; existing preview sequences keep their pinned generation.

boundaries: Record the failed outcome under the owner fence and preserve the previous published data.
